elements.name: wide elevated view of large bus station yard
long rows of parked long-distance buses
tall lamp posts with warm light
many small dark figures moving between buses
dark city with a few lit windows behind

wrong_setting: Most buses read as generic short city buses rather than long-distance coaches, and the central bus is parked at an angle in open ground instead of in a row; nothing else specifically places it in Addis Ababa.
notes: Remove the dark vignette and rounded, darkened corners so the painting runs edge to edge. Turn the buses into long-distance coaches parked in clear long rows, with the centre bus lined up in the yard.
